note: SIMULATED: every number comes from the PETAL Locate simulator and models with illustrative link parameters and nominal orbital slots (config/pacific-uhf.yaml), not from real satellites, terminals or sites.
method: core.accuracy.accuracy_map at each point (one TDOA and one FDOA per pair, MATH.md section 10) for the pairs the tasking rule picks for a jammer there (sim.montecarlo.plan_event: primary channel by received C/N0, one partner per other satellite by downlink quality, same-site preference within 3 dB), one 1 s capture per pair. 'operator': the configured operator-grade one-sigma ephemeris (RIC 100/1000/1000 m, 0.02/0.02/0.05 m/s); 'tle': every satellite at the TLE-grade sigmas (2/20/10 km, 0.3/0.3/0.7 m/s). Every prediction carries the propagation media at the configured one-sigma (media_assumed_by_solver: 30 TECU, correlation 0.5; 2.4 m zenith delay, correlation 0.9) unless media_variants says otherwise. 'calibrated-guam': differenced against the configured Guam reference (shared-1); 'calibrated-nearest-whatif': the same reference design moved to the nearest of the what-if sites. media_tdoa_ns: the TDOA each pair's row would carry from a 30 TECU ionosphere and a 2.4 m troposphere at every ground end (core.media), uncalibrated and left after differencing against the Guam reference. media_variants: the 03 UTC prediction with the solver's assumed media sigmas (VTEC TECU, zenith m) set to the listed values. reference_placement: the Guam reference design moved 650 or 1,300 km from the point at eight bearings, calibrated 95 % semi-major at the four epochs. Distances in m; semi-major of the 95 % ellipse; CEP50 of P_total.
